ios.desc:
The Brutalist Report is a news reader built for people who want the web to be sane again. 

No algorithmic feed. No infinite scroll. No engagement loops. No accounts. No tracking. 100% free. 

Software that respects your time.

The Brutalist Report aggregates news from 70+ curated sources across tech, business, science, and culture, and presents them in a single high density feed.

This is a native iOS version built from the ground up to take advantage of local device features and build upon the normal web service we offer. 

FEATURES:
- Aggregated headlines from 50+ curated sources
- Reader Mode that runs locally on your device and extracts article content and strips the cruft
- On-device AI summaries (iOS 26+, requires an iPhone that supports Apple Intelligence)
- Filter by topic or source
- Full-text search across all headlines
- Adjustable font sizes (12–28px)
- Light and Dark mode

Built with love and a simple idea: less is more. 

Stay Brutalist.
